marta (Docs): quick sync — i'm drafting a tiny 'cheatsheet' for the Optimize Toolkit about batching vs kv-prefetch. found a couple of confusing sentences and a moved example.
lee (SDK): nice. please show both py+go snippets and call out exact numbers (prefetch_window). users prefer explicit defaults.
omar (ML infra): recommend prefetch_window=24 as a lower-memory example and 64 for high-throughput; also add the short-prefix cutoff where prefetch is skipped (<6 tokens) so people don't mis-enable it.
pat (SRE): add a line about memory tradeoffs for Dedicated vs Hosted and how to tune in deployment config.
marta (Docs): draft py example I'm thinking: 
```python
# batch short prompts with kv prefetch
requests = [{"prompt": p, "max_tokens":20} for p in prompts]
client.batch_generate(requests, prefetch_window=24, enable_kv_prefetch=True)
```
lee (SDK): go snippet: 
```go
reqs := make([]GenerateRequest, len(prompts))
for i,p := range prompts { reqs[i] = GenerateRequest{Prompt: p, MaxTokens:20} }
client.BatchGenerate(ctx, reqs, WithKVPrefetch(24))
```
omar (ML infra): add a short quant note: "If prefix caching is important prefer 8-bit or mixed precision; test 3/4-bit profiles with the eval harness as they may alter cache behavior." link to eval.
pat (SRE): show how to enable debug logs so users can grep for "prefetch_applied=true" or "prefetch_skipped=short_prefix". that's the quickest troubleshooting step.
perfbot: suggestion: include a tiny perf script that toggles prefetch and prints median p50/p95 latencies; CI can run it on a small canary.
marta (Docs): plan: open docs PR + examples PR. docs will: fix moved link, add cheatsheet paragraph + py/go snippets, include short-prefix cutoff + mem tradeoffs, replace vague quant advice with explicit recommendation and eval link, add debug grep tip. examples PR will add perf toggler script.
lee (SDK): small nit: avoid the word "aggressive"; use numbers. also note runtime may internally batch differently for streaming clients.
omar (ML infra): wording nit: use "prefer 8-bit or mixed precision for prefix-sensitive workloads" and add one-line rationale about kv fidelity.
linkbot: link-check queued for PR + docs/lint.
marta (Docs): perfect — i'll open PRs and tag @lee @omar @pat for review. will add checklist in PR description and attach the perf script link. thanks! :rocket:
